## Changed dashboard presentation and recovery
src/screens/Registration.tsx previously rendered only queue counts despite real server entries. It now renders returned patient/slip/token/ticket/payment status rows under the server doctor/department, adds read-only Refresh queues, hides stale rows on loading/error, and triggers rereads after confirmed local intake/ticket reload as well as existing event/resync. src/registration-i18n.ts and src/foundation-help.ts add bilingual queue guidance and clear unpaid/patient-only prerequisites.

## Real DEV evidence
node scripts/registration-queue-visibility-check.mjs --baseline reproduced missing slip rows with a nonempty real response. The updated read-only check PASS: both returned entries displayed exactly, failed real GET response hides stale rows with visible error, explicit retry restores list without clearing intake draft, F1 help and Urdu/high contrast250 no document overflow. Zero business writes; original preferences restored and signedout. npm run build PASS (30screens/559controls/182groups, TS/Vite); npm test79PASS. docs/REGISTRATION_QUEUE_VISIBILITY_REVIEW_2026-10-25.md and docs/registration-queue-visibility-evidence-2026-10-25.json retain results.

## Scope and limits
This is changed endpoint UI/recovery evidence at a new tested commit, not unchanged accepted work. No new registration/payment/live-event handover was repeated; no event, full test-plan, human review, translation/editor or full-screen completion claim. A separate user-reported missing visit was read-only traced as correctly assigned but Issued/Unpaid with no queue; it was not modified. No backend queue defect reproduced.
